sermon.title: Relationship with God— December 5, 2021
sermon.speaker: Michael Silla
sermon.summary: God draws us out of darkness and calls us up the mountain to meet Him. Lay aside the weight of sin, exercise prayer, fasting, worship and the word daily, and stick with the river—Jesus, the way, the truth and the life—like Josiah did.
